items.prompt: Not a cost to manage, ___ a capability to build.

items.hintAfterError: Mantenha o paralelismo: os três elementos da tríade têm a mesma forma verbal.

items.prompt: The data is the business; the systems are the business; the people who build them ___ the business.
Every trade-off we make should be visible, explained and ___.
Technology ___ strategy possible; people make it real.

When IT works, it is ___; when it fails, everyone notices.

items.hintAfterError: Depois de 'is not' a posição pede um adjetivo, não um substantivo.

items.prompt: Quietly, consistently and ___, good leaders make the business work.
